title: Hypothesis brief (engage-crucible Step 2)
description: One brief per dispatched hypothesis path. The falsificationCondition field is the AC3 gate — empty or missing values are rejected.

predictions.description: Observable consequences if the hypothesis is true.

falsificationCondition.description: Specific, measurable observation that would disprove the hypothesis. AC3 gate — empty or missing values fail validation. Must reference a measurable observation, not a philosophical or unfalsifiable condition.

priorEvidenceBase.description: Citations supporting the hypothesis. Each citation conforms to citation-schema.json with an evidenceTier value. May be empty when --offline is set.

assumptions.description: Load-bearing assumptions whose violation would invalidate the hypothesis.

artefact.description: Structured experimental-design artefact conforming to the schema named by artefactType. Pure prose without a structured payload fails validation (AC4).
